items.prompt: After receiving [1,2,100], this running median reports 2.0. What would a separate window-of-two median report?

options.why: The implemented prefix algorithm retains 1; it has no expiration/deletion mechanism.

options.text: 2.0, because rebalancing deletes the oldest price.
options.why: Rebalancing transfers values between heaps; it does not remove the observation 1.

options.text: 100.0, because a window always uses its last value.
options.why: A two-observation median averages the middle pair.

options.text: 1.5, because the first two values are the window.
options.why: A trailing window of two after the third arrival contains the latest two, not the first two.
